newsitem.title: USA: Foster Wheeler Yangcheng, China, pact ok'd.
newsitem.headline: Foster Wheeler Yangcheng, China, pact ok'd.

text.p: Foster Wheeler Energy Corp said Monday it received a Notice to Proceed for the design and supply of six steam generators for a "coal-by-wire" power project in China.
The contract, valued at more than $350 million, was awarded to Foster Wheeler in the third quarter of 1996, the company said in a news release.
Foster Wheeler Energy Corp is a U.S. subsidiary of Foster Wheeler Energy International Inc.
Yangcheng International Power Generating Co Ltd, which gave the notice to proceed on the steam generators, will be used the for Yangcheng No. 1 power plant in Shanxi Province, southwest of Beijing.
Foster Wheeler said the contract will provide a baseload of work for Foster Wheeler Energy International for five years.

The company said the contract is the first major project to utilize China's "coal-by-wire" concept for development of that country's energy sector. "Coal-by-wire" refers to a program in which power plants are situated next to coal mines rather than near the final consumers of the power being generated.
The schedule calls for the first generator to go into commercial operation in late 1999.
